To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the success of a brand extension is dependent on the brand's trustworthiness, the perceived quality of the brand and the perceived fit between the brand and the extension.

the attitude towards brand extension advertisement and perceived quality are significant determinants of consumers' attitude towards a brand extension, while brand trust and fit only emerge as significant determinants in the presence of interaction terms.
the brand trust and brand extension advertisement attitude are the most important factors affecting consumers' attitude to brand extensions.
In summary, our research is concerned with
understanding the determinants of consumers' evaluation for brand extension of consumer packaged goods (CPGs) with a focus on the Indian context.
the evaluation of brand extension and its impact on consumers' attitudes and behavioural intentions.
understanding how Indian consumers evaluate the brand extensions of CPGs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
brand trust, perceived quality, and attitude towards brand extension advertisement are the major determinants of consumers' attitude towards the brand extension.
brand trust, perceived quality, attitude towards brand extension advertisement and brand extension fit are the most important determinants of brand extension success in the Indian context.
the attitude towards brand extension advertisement has the most significant impact on attitude towards brand extension, followed by perceived quality of the extension product and perceived fit.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
brand extension evaluation is a complex process and is affected by many factors.
the study has identified factors that influence consumers' evaluation of a brand extension and has also provided insights into how these factors interact with one another.
this study provides an understanding of the factors that contribute to consumers' evaluation of CPG brand extensions in India.
The main takeaway from our work is that
marketers should not only focus on brand equity and perceived fit but also on the brand extension's perceived quality and the brand's trust.
brand extension evaluation is a complex task and requires a thorough understanding of consumers' perceptions and attitudes.
marketers need to be very careful while introducing brand extensions in the Indian market, as consumers are very cautious about brand extensions and are very critical of them.
